title: 木組み — The Joinery Journey
tagline: A public roadmap from zero tools to kanawa tsugi.
intro: I've built exactly one thing: a flat workbench, with western techniques. I own no Japanese tools and know nothing about Japanese woodworking yet. This site is my open notebook — every milestone, every dollar, every hour — as I try to learn the craft properly.
fxNote: Prices listed in JPY are converted at roughly ¥150 = $1 for planning only; check the linked store for the current price.
